commit_readback.message: Qualify recipe-first parser, runtime and Maven repairs with explicit artifact custody

execution_reports.scope: Actual three production materializations, parser/composition/framing 64 cases, catalogue 17 cases, and separately corrected snapshot API/provenance oracle 11 cases passed; original unchanged snapshot oracle retains its 10-pass/1-failure result and all failed trials remain retained. No whole-reactor or native qualification.
Two actual recipe-produced Java owners with five snapshot cases under both original and composed parsers; exact postimages and fixed-point materializations. Finite recipe execution only.

Original six-case baseline has five passes and one failure; current six-case candidate, full 12-case and optional-pack-absent nine-case lanes passed; exact 62/63 plan inventories and four public/protected API descriptor comparisons preserved. No JDK/JNI/native/performance admission.

Actual local empty-cache replay seeded 1978 exact files and passed five offline cases without cache drift. The published mirror remains incomplete: the exact Kotlin compiler binary is absent, so this does not establish offline replay from the published checkout.

Existing structured POM recipe passed eight offline cases, actual materialization and independent fixed point; exactly one 164-byte compile-edge insertion; current 41-POM graph and byte/node preservation reviewed. Optional profile, whole-reactor and native/shaded gates remain pending.
